notes: fw v0.1.2 — the zero-typing provisioning firmware: WiFi-only first-boot form, POST /provision, + all audit repairs + the TFT block protocol.

bug_fixes: THE 94% STALL, ROOT-CAUSED: the display remembers a partially-written image across power cycles and asks every new upload to RESUME at its write pointer (655360 = exactly where a previous transfer died) - the updater called that absurd and restarted, so the display re-asked forever. The updater now honors the resume: it catches up (fetching the skipped bytes to keep the recorded checksum true), streams from the display's pointer, and the image completes
